propositions: A new pause/resume surface must preserve dual-format gate blobs with both legacy gated_mode and new pause metadata while supporting old reader compatibility
Pause operations must exit 0 with exact anchored JSON BRIDGE_PAUSED marker before lock acquisition or mutation, and the workflow must recognize only that complete marker to skip commit-and-push
Pause bloobs must carry git user.email as who, first-pause UTC RFC3339 as paused_at, refuse different reasons or missing identity without overwriting, and preserve metadata on same-reason re-pause
Resume must use expected-old-OID CAS semantics with explicit conflict surfacing, succeed when unpaused, and recover corrupt blobs by clearing the ref without decoding
Corrupt remote gates must exit 1 with recovery instructions and no traceback, allowing clean recovery via resume without lock or mutation
Legacy reconcile-check early return, old reconcile vocabulary, and existing gated-mode exit behavior must remain functional and unchanged across all environments
